name: Earthing, Bonding & Lightning Protection — buried-grid-first, test before energize

activities: install below-slab earth grid/ring before slab pour
connect to foundation steel (Ufer) where accessible
sequence.note: The buried grid is a hold-point on the civil programme — it must go in before slabs/backfill cover it.

activities: equipotential bonding of structural steel, pipework and containment
bond roof plant and metal masses
connect down conductors to the earth ring
connect switchgear, transformers (body and neutral), generators, DBs, motors to earth
clean/instrument earth for electronics where specified
LPS down-conductor continuity and test-joint resistance

typical_relationships.reason: the ring/rods are laid in the ground before slabs and backfill
the grid must be inspected and recorded before it is permanently covered
equipment earths connect back to the established grid/main earth bar
air terminals and mesh are fixed to a completed, watertight roof
energizing before a proven earth is a safety violation
steel must be up before it can be bonded/used as a down conductor

interfaces.requirement: buried grid, earth pits and foundation earth must be installed before slabs/backfill cover them
energization requires the earth grid connected and resistance-tested; provides neutral earthing
provides the earth reference that tray/ladder runs bond to
steel bonded to earth / used as natural down-conductor per LPS design
roof-mounted plant must be bonded into the LPS
provides clean/instrument earth reference for signal circuits and IS

testing_requirements: LPS down-conductor continuity and test-joint resistance
Touch/step voltage survey at MV substations
commissioning_dependencies: Earthing installed and resistance-tested before any energization
Earth pit test records signed off
typical_exceptions: High-resistivity/rock soil needs chemical or deep-driven electrodes (extra scope and re-test)
Foundation (Ufer) earthing only where rebar is accessible before pour
evidence: Equipment energization was scheduled before the earth-electrode resistance test, the buried earth grid was set to be backfilled before its inspection record, and LPS air terminations were sequenced before the roof was watertight.
